scope: Five matched simulation studies of 15rad/s target slew. No installation or hardware approval.

contracts: continuous 15rad/s target slew each physics step
protocol.stop_definition: Planar speed <=0.02m/s and |yaw|<=0.05rad/s continuously for0.5s; reset/timeouts count as failures.
protocol.evaluation_randomization: Play config retains startup physics randomization and observation noise. --randomized was false, so training-time command/reset curriculum was not selected.
protocol.reward_change: Precision std0.08 vs baseline sqrt(.1); reward penalizes XY command error plus body vertical velocity squared.

limitations: One training seed per arm, not independent replicated training.
Per-segment means weight commands equally; inspect command table rather than treating aggregate as general speed.
Configured failure termination is not an exhaustive stability detector or hardware failure probability.
50Hz applied-target trace confirms sampled delta bounds only;250Hz action tests/GPU smoke and520Hz native command instrumentation separately cover per-update implementation.
Target slew is an engineering command bound, not a motor speed, acceleration, torque or hardware safety guarantee.
Reactivation seeds from measured clipped joint positions; continuity across two different controllers is outside the contract.
Training/play has torso contact only; native checks use all9hulls, a different solver and rate; physical robot still required.

baseline_vs_prefiltered.interpretation: Positive means candidate metric increased. Effort/stopping differences depend on achieved movement; these are not utility scores.

precision_vs_baseline.interpretation: Positive means candidate metric increased. Effort/stopping differences depend on achieved movement; these are not utility scores.

baseline_vs_counterfactual-legacy-baseli.interpretation: Positive means candidate metric increased. Effort/stopping differences depend on achieved movement; these are not utility scores.

precision_vs_counterfactual-legacy-preci.interpretation: Positive means candidate metric increased. Effort/stopping differences depend on achieved movement; these are not utility scores.

decision.reason: No candidate dominates tracking, effort, turning, clipping and contact behavior. Baseline lowers effort/yaw/slip but retains a low-command dead zone and increased target clipping. Precision improves translation at larger commands while worsening yaw tracking. None has physical validation.

candidate_roles.baseline: Lower-effort/yaw-focused candidate for supervised comparison; not precise low-speed locomotion.
candidate_roles.precision: Translation-focused candidate for supervised comparison; not a universal replacement.
candidate_roles.prefiltered: Original5498 control with explicit slew, retained as reproducible fallback candidate.
candidate_roles.counterfactual-legacy-baseline: Matched training-budget control, retained for attribution.
candidate_roles.counterfactual-legacy-precision: Matched training-budget control, retained for attribution.

decision.controller_requirement: Every exported candidate requires the new position_target_slew_v1 controller and exact loaded contract verified by readiness. Old binaries ignore unknown JSON metadata and are not acceptable.
decision.rate_limit_scope: 15rad/s is a command bound from motion guidance, not a hardware speed rating. Within activation each physical update is limited. Activation reseeds from measured clipped position, so no continuity guarantee from another controller last target.
remaining_gaps: Actual robot driver limits, firmware, controller binary and physical tests remain unverified.
Nearzero±0.05m/s commands substantially undertrack in all candidates; baseline is nearly stationary.

Soft torso contacts penetrate the nominal plane by up to2.60–3.06mm in scored samples; instantaneous startup/contact maxima reach8.05–10.07mm. This is simulator contact compliance evidence, not proof of real clearance.
Desired actor requests still have large steps, up to1.62–1.97rad between valid50Hz samples; the actuator-facing contract does the limiting.
Native nominal9hull checks are separate from randomized GPU1hull simulation; neither is a substitute for perturbation and robot testing.
No final standing walking-controller reactivation is included after Spider exit in this bounded native protocol.
decision.next_experiment_hypothesis: If more software optimization is pursued, compare an intermediate translation reward width or explicitly balance yaw weight while preserving the same slew/physical contract, seeds, budget and per-command evaluation. Do not tune solely to aggregate effort or assume more training is better.

visual_review.reviewed: Six matched snapshots at6.5,12,17,21,27,32s show coherent low Spider stance and completed standing exit; all sampled pose/tilt metrics independently reviewed. No claim of exhaustive frame-by-frame video review.

preservation.scope: All five complete archives, safe extracted run data, native traces, exports, scripts, visual outputs and independent archive receipts. Hash/size verification is required before reporting durable completion.
